test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All black is white.

Some white is grey.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some grey is black.

II. Some white is black.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All black is white.

Some white is grey.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eff7d4a0cb5769d720db2a727976cae0bc68b7ff3dd327b6d89abba9ba7db2cf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some grey is black - False (Because, No definite relation given between grey and black, so it can be possible only).

II. Some white is black - True (Because, All black is white implies that some white is black).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
